Name: Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience
Additional Ability: Battle Spirit
Descriptions:
When Caesar activates <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Parry Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> through <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, she buffs all squad members with a <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>300%</color> of her base Impact + <color=#2BAD00>200</color>. The shield lasts for 60s and is equipped by the active character, with its value shared among all squad members. Any single instance of DMG will not exceed the shield value.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, the shield bearer's Anti-Interrupt level is increased.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, the shield bearer's ATK is increased by <color=#2BAD00>40</color>. After <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> expires, this buff remains for an additional 5s.

When another character in your squad can activate <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> or shares the same Faction:
When Caesar activates <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dead End</color>, she applies a Debuff effect to enemies within a 7m radius, increasing the damage they take from all squad members by 25% for 30s.

Cons.Name: Spearhead Advance
Cons.Effect: When Caesar enters combat or switches in, she instantly buffs all squad members with a <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s. While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.

Cons.Name: Legacy of the Far Lands
Cons.Effect: While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience</color> is active, Caesar's Energy Generation Rate increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's ATK boost is increased to 150% of its original value.

Cons.Name: Aries the Battering-Ram
Cons.Effect: When Caesar uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 3 additional <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color>. If her Energy is below 20, she can activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> instead. This substitution can trigger once every 5s.

Cons.Name: Overlord's Will
Cons.Effect: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> are guaranteed to trigger a critical hit. The skill's DMG is increased by 50% and deals additional 50% DMG to the primary target. When Caesar uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, her CRIT Rate is increased by 30% and her CRIT DMG is increased by 60% for 15s.
